name: Vegan Beet "Poke" Bowl with Edamame, Snap Peas, Carrots & Sesame Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium beets
6 medium carrots
1 ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
1 ½ avocados
1 small pkg chives
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Trim, peel, and cut beets into ½-inch cubes. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spread beets out in an even layer; place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Peel and grate carrots; transfer to a large platter.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the platter.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out onto the platter. Set veggies aside.
Place mayo, water, tahini, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sesame mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup vegan mayonnaise
3 tbsp tahini
salt

instructions.primary_message: Mince chives. Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place in a large bowl along with vinegar, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Transfer roasted beets to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the "poke."
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Arrange beet "poke," edamame, and veggies on top. Drizzle with sesame mayo and enjoy!
